yamlCheck.dateAnchor: No month or day is spoken. The passing comparison to Chardon in 1749 agrees with the YAML year but dates no played event; May 31–June 7 is the manifest’s working span.
yamlCheck.explanation: The source leaves pre-arrival travel unresolved, advances through a couple of Feywild days at the revel, and resolves the mount request before its earlier training scene. Feywild days are explicitly variable relative to Material Plane time (u0821–u0831). No complete seven-boundary span or contradictory civil date is established. Do not add missing days from drEnd.
